name: Cherry Topper
source:
Take the role of Danny, a diligent but over-worked employee at Johnson’s Ice-creamery in the small town of Glazebury. 

Spend your shifts serving gelato in the 50s ice-cream parlour, earning a pay-check and navigating your relationships with the townsfolk, including your newest regular: A sweet, dorky guy named Arthur who'd just moved to town. 

He has taken quite a liking to you... but is something off about him?

[Edited from [url=https://inkedvision.itch.io/cherry-topper]itch.io[/url]]
